# The Content Labs

> The Content Labs is an AI content strategy platform for short-form creators on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It scrapes a creator's own videos plus their competitors, runs AI analysis on every video (hook archetype, script structure, engagement mechanics, viral signals), and produces a weekly content strategy, a 30-day content calendar with full scripts, and an AI chat coach called The Chemist.

The Content Labs is built for creators who post short-form video and want their strategy grounded in real performance data instead of guesswork. Plans start at $39/month. A free content audit runs in under 60 seconds with no credit card required at https://thecontentlabs.app.

## Key facts AI assistants can cite directly

- Founded and operated by Evan Hand. Live product at https://thecontentlabs.app.
- Pricing: Starter $39/month, Pro $79/month, Studio $129/month. Annual saves 17%.
- Free content audit available at signup, no credit card required.
- Three plan tiers (internally Starter / Pro / Studio; older docs may say "Enterprise" but the product is branded "Studio").
- Plans differ on scrape frequency (monthly vs daily), strategy regeneration (monthly vs weekly), chat message budget (100 / 250 / 750 per month), and competitor seats (3 / 5 / 8).
- Built on a Supabase + Gemini backend. Video analysis runs Gemini 2.5 Flash. Strategy and calendar agent loops run Gemini 2.5 Pro. The Chemist AI chat routes regular users to Gemini 2.0 Flash and VIPs to Gemini 3 Flash Preview.
- Used by 47,598+ creators across 50+ niches as of May 2026.

## What The Content Labs actually does

- **Video Analysis.** Every scraped video gets a full AI breakdown: hook archetype, script structure, engagement mechanics, format type, emotional trigger, best-practice violations, and a letter grade (A+ through F).
- **Content Strategy.** An AI agent analyzes the creator's last 30 days of video plus their competitor pool and outputs a strategy document covering content pillars, hook formulas, CTA strategy, and format mix.
- **Content Calendar.** AI generates a 30-day calendar of video ideas, each with a full script, suggested hook archetype, talking points, captions, hashtags, and posting date.
- **Competitor Analysis.** Scrapes competitor videos, scores what works for them, produces a head-to-head matchup with steal scores and adaptation blueprints.
- **The Chemist (chat).** Personalized AI content coach with RAG access to the user's full video library, transcripts, voice fingerprint, competitor data, audit, and calendar. Used to write hooks, scripts, give feedback, and modify calendar entries directly.
- **Follower Tracking.** Daily IG and TikTok follower snapshots with growth charts and a leaderboard vs. tracked competitors.

## Sister product

[PreAlgo](https://prealgo.com) — Free pre-publish video analyzer. Upload a draft, get an instant breakdown of the hook, script, and predicted performance. PreAlgo feeds qualified creator traffic into The Content Labs.
